sources.title: The open-source large language model llm-jp-3-440m - Supports ...
sources.snippet: LLM-jp-3-440m is a 440M parameter version in the Japanese large language model series developed by the Large Language Model R & D Center of the National Institute of Informatics in Japan. This model is based on the Transformer architecture, supports multiple languages such as Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean, and is pre - trained on a large - scale multilingual dataset.
